business_problem: The challenge was clear: Oda needed to maintain full control over its entire software stack, from shop applications and web front end to warehouse management systems and delivery logistics, all while ensuring that data remained accessible and actionable for every employee.
solution_summary: The challenge was clear: Oda needed to maintain full control over its entire software stack, from shop applications and web front end to warehouse management systems and delivery logistics, all while ensuring that data remained accessible and actionable for every employee. Automated user management through a custom Looker API Slack bot Oda leverages Looker to democratize data, driving efficiency from the C-suite to warehouse operations. Key components include Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform coordinates multi-agent workflows, tool calling, and governed automation across the application; Looker provides the governed semantic layer, dashboards, and self-service analytics used by business teams. Reported outcomes include Hundreds of weekly active users across all organizational levels.
